acceptance_cases.stimulus: Objective omits critical-service definition, stage dates or target units.
acceptance_cases.expected: Missing required fields shown as questions; no guessed values, edits, sends or submissions.

acceptance_cases.stimulus: Goal requests unsupported frequency/dynamics or standalone AC without admitted dispatch.
acceptance_cases.expected: Fresh native support reason; unsupported steps blocked, no substitute adequacy/compliance claim.

acceptance_cases.stimulus: Open one card walkthrough in Guided, change a native field in Expert and return.
acceptance_cases.expected: Single companion/entry; shared source reflected, focus/keyboard/reduced-motion usable; composer never auto-sends.

acceptance_cases.stimulus: Card deselected but another selected run consumes its price/VOLL input.
acceptance_cases.expected: Outside-scope results excluded; consumed prerequisites remain visible; no silent selection or parameter loss.

acceptance_cases.stimulus: Provider proposes 13 steps, nested task control, project-rebinding or invalid forward refs.
acceptance_cases.expected: Native admission refuses; no splitting into hidden loops or crossing project scope.

acceptance_cases.stimulus: Inspect exact edit then deny normal confirmation.
acceptance_cases.expected: Native write/queue counters stay zero; denial retained, no alternate tool or direct file route.

acceptance_cases.stimulus: Approve edit on owned source; source, lock or restriction changes before admission.
acceptance_cases.expected: Fresh denial/stale refusal, zero effect; prior inspected plan grants no bypass.

acceptance_cases.stimulus: Apply supported exact edit and read back before starting dependent work.
acceptance_cases.expected: Only declared fields change; source/target digests and native receipt match; dependent step waits for verified readback.

acceptance_cases.stimulus: Submit supported bounded case, then lose worker or queue acknowledgment.
acceptance_cases.expected: Uncertain effect blocks dependents; no retry/reservation reset; unrelated same-input job cannot certify it.

acceptance_cases.stimulus: Exhaust engine/campaign/session allowance and propose larger plan-domain capability.
acceptance_cases.expected: Existing limits and narrower execution adapter prevail; no hidden solves, cap changes or inferred dollar allowance.

acceptance_cases.stimulus: Change objective or assumptions after proposal review.
acceptance_cases.expected: Preview/affected approval invalidated; updated native review before effects; unchanged future actions not preapproved.

acceptance_cases.stimulus: Restart or reopen completed, interrupted and unresolved task; manually reconcile with a caller-supplied completed result.
acceptance_cases.expected: Completed effects not replayed; uncertainty/ACL preserved; old approvals not restored; claimed completion needs independently re-read matching native evidence.

acceptance_cases.stimulus: Cancel while current native job continues.
acceptance_cases.expected: Future steps stop; job truthfully running until native cancellation/terminal proof; no false quiescence.

acceptance_cases.stimulus: Native result is infeasible, partial, failed or missing exact artifacts.
acceptance_cases.expected: No completed-study claim; typed native diagnosis, correction draft only, no auto-retry.

acceptance_cases.stimulus: Prepare final Hand-off with unsupported chapter and stale historical result.
acceptance_cases.expected: Exact source/status links and gaps; no silent live fallback, universal report claim or input restore.

acceptance_cases.stimulus: Resume user whose project permission was revoked or browser view changed.
acceptance_cases.expected: No foreign sources or effects; navigation claim requires available native ACK, not model text.

acceptance_cases.stimulus: Ask best option with no objective or cost/reliability weights.
acceptance_cases.expected: Clarify criterion; do not invent weights/probabilities or choose an unconditional winner.

acceptance_cases.stimulus: Compare fixtures differing in horizon, currency/price year, demand, weights or dispatch basis.
acceptance_cases.expected: Native incompatible-basis refusal with reasons; no fabricated deltas or silent conversions.

acceptance_cases.stimulus: Compare intentionally changed designs with admitted equivalent basis and exact receipts.
acceptance_cases.expected: Declared changes retained; independent expected native delta agrees; no identical-input-only shortcut.

acceptance_cases.stimulus: Compare feasible design with cheaper infeasible, missing or corrupt alternative.
acceptance_cases.expected: Non-feasible alternative not ranked successful; exact unavailable/feasibility reasons retained.

acceptance_cases.stimulus: Inspect cross-card decision when Control is off and grid evidence is linear-only.
acceptance_cases.expected: Outside scope and proxy fidelity explicit; no compliance/frequency proof; source links and accessibility verified.

acceptance_cases.stimulus: BESS plus PV fixture, PV-only counterfactual and zero-sized battery.
acceptance_cases.expected: Independent incremental value oracle agrees; PV savings not assigned to battery; zero-size has no investment verdict.

acceptance_cases.stimulus: Supported tornado crosses native investment threshold or lacks required range.
acceptance_cases.expected: Native marginal/not-established verdict used; fixed-size re-dispatch versus revaluation disclosed.

acceptance_cases.stimulus: Supported adequacy frontier with known cost/service points and infeasible target.
acceptance_cases.expected: Independent domain oracle; only admitted feasible points compared, no invented cross-domain Pareto/ranking.

acceptance_cases.stimulus: User supplies low/high bounds with no probabilities and correlated assumptions.
acceptance_cases.expected: Ranges preserved with provenance; no distribution, probability of success or independence assumption invented.

acceptance_cases.stimulus: Native plausibility rule unsupported or threshold unavailable.
acceptance_cases.expected: Rule not-evaluated with reason; no model-defined pass or calls to removed tool stubs.

acceptance_cases.stimulus: Higher storage cost coincides with changed constraints/dispatch and unexpected sensitivity sign.
acceptance_cases.expected: No automatic bug claim; actual varied inputs/method stated; native controlled fixture needed for causal conclusion.

acceptance_cases.stimulus: Provider uses correct numeric token with wrong unit, sign, source case or causal attribution.
acceptance_cases.expected: Semantic/source gate withholds claim even when token-only number audit would match.

acceptance_cases.stimulus: Provider proposes 13 facts, invented break-even, missing NPV or aggregate confidence percentage.
acceptance_cases.expected: Fact bound enforced; unsupported numeric/decision claim withheld, strict publication refuses disagreement.

acceptance_cases.stimulus: Open evidence map for verified calculation with assumed inputs and no domain review.
acceptance_cases.expected: Dimensions stay distinct; assumptions/review gap visible, no green approval/certification score.

acceptance_cases.stimulus: Ask which extra study could help and inspect proposed scenarios.
acceptance_cases.expected: Explanation/proposal only, no queue/send; LC-17 cap/ranges and existing edit preview retained.

acceptance_cases.stimulus: Export comparison after source changes or a chapter is unavailable.
acceptance_cases.expected: Digest recheck refuses stale export; availability explicit; no full network/report certification.

acceptance_cases.stimulus: Upload hostile prompts, macro/formula workbook, foreign file reference or oversized/archive payload.
acceptance_cases.expected: Existing bounds/ACL apply; no code/formula/link execution, secrets disclosure or effect from file text.

acceptance_cases.stimulus: EU local-time meter fixtures across spring/autumn DST, mixed offsets, gaps and partial year.
acceptance_cases.expected: Native importer rules preserved; unit/time conversions match independent energy oracle; repairs/refusals visible.

acceptance_cases.stimulus: North American 15-minute kWh versus average-kW meter values and missing unit.
acceptance_cases.expected: Energy/power conversion matches interval oracle; missing/conflicting unit unresolved; no silent default MW.

acceptance_cases.stimulus: Map equipment column to multiple entities or H2 mass/energy/currency-year field without basis.
acceptance_cases.expected: Ambiguity stays unmapped; typed schema validation, exact source cells/hash and required basis shown.

acceptance_cases.stimulus: Preview a profile via load family versus Library series and correct mapping in Expert.
acceptance_cases.expected: Each parser retains its timezone/coverage semantics; one shared preview, no writes or sends; corrected target visible in Guided.

acceptance_cases.stimulus: Deny apply after staging mapping.
acceptance_cases.expected: Native model/profile unchanged and no solve; ordinary denial retained.

acceptance_cases.stimulus: Replace source bytes, edit target or revoke access after mapping inspection.
acceptance_cases.expected: Digest/ACL/restriction recheck refuses stale apply; old preview cannot authorize new content.

acceptance_cases.stimulus: Apply reviewed small profile/asset mapping through admitted tools.
acceptance_cases.expected: Exact fields/profile applied once; native readback, full source hash, transformations and provenance retained.

acceptance_cases.stimulus: Repeat import request with same content/target, then changed mapping.
acceptance_cases.expected: Existing native idempotency/explicit duplicate choice; no duplicate assets/series; conflicting request refused.

acceptance_cases.stimulus: Fail halfway through a nontransactional multi-operation apply.
acceptance_cases.expected: Partial effects recorded and further work stopped; no all-or-nothing/auto-rollback or snapshot-undo claim.

acceptance_cases.stimulus: Native profile repairs small gaps or assumes UTC, then corrected source is applied.
acceptance_cases.expected: Repair/assumption lineage explicit in preview/readback; corrected write reviewed; original evidence not silently erased.

acceptance_cases.stimulus: Readable PDF contains unsupported tariff component, PPA clause or ambiguous equipment basis.
acceptance_cases.expected: No executable/full-support claim; incomplete native semantics reported; manual clarification route.

acceptance_cases.stimulus: Admitted document-family fixture includes repeated values on different pages and extraction error.
acceptance_cases.expected: Page/region/source digest correct; wrong extraction withheld; independent labeled extraction fixture used.

acceptance_cases.stimulus: Request external lookup, redistribution or paid model processing of sensitive file.
acceptance_cases.expected: No automatic feed/terms clearance/provider call; permitted disclosure controls and manual path available.

acceptance_cases.stimulus: Try to use short millisecond trace as annual planning demand and claim dynamic proof.
acceptance_cases.expected: Native coverage/refusal and fidelity boundary shown; no silent shape fabrication or claimed dynamic validation.

acceptance_cases.stimulus: User rejects/corrects extracted field and proceeds manually on narrow screen/keyboard.
acceptance_cases.expected: No forced model usage; native editor and remaining gaps usable; no duplicate import, Save/Export or assistant entries.
